body:
# Mods Updater

Fabric mod for Minecraft that checks installed mods against [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/) and shows which ones have updates.

## Features

- Hash-based lookup against the Modrinth `/version_files/update` endpoint, with a slug-based fallback for mods that aren't matched by hash.
- Toast notification on world join when updates are available.
- Dedicated screen accessible from [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu): click the configure icon next to "Mod Updates" to open the list. Double-click an entry to open its Modrinth page.
- Single locale-bundled with English and Russian.

## Requirements

- Minecraft `>= 26.1.2`
- Java `25`
- Fabric Loader `>= 0.19.2`
- Fabric API
- (Optional) ModMenu — recommended for the UI screen.

## Building

```sh
./gradlew build
```

The resulting jar is in `build/libs/`.
